    StartersWarm olives, almonds and parmesan crispsOlives with orange and fennel, rosemary almonds, baked parmesan roundsHow to make it250g olives2 tbsp olive oil1 strip of orange peel1 tsp fennel seeds150g almonds1 sprig of rosemary1 tsp salt100g parmesan, gratedWarm the olives in the oil with orange peel and fennel seeds.Roast the almonds at 170°C with rosemary and salt.Bake small rounds of parmesan at 190°C.Serve in little bowls.Someone in the Crowd smash slidersThe Hollywood party by the poolHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin beef patties smashed on a smoking griddle with caramelised onion, cheddar, pickles and a spicy burger sauce on toasted brioche slider buns.Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 20 minutes.Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sriracha and 1 tbsp chopped pickles.Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls.Smash thin on a smoking hot pan, salt, cook 90 seconds, flip, top with cheddar and onions and cook 1 minute.Toast 12 brioche slider buns, spread with sauce and add a patty and pickles.Charcuterie with cornichons and grissiniSamba.
